title: Froning Family Book
show_partner_path: Show direct path across the family tree between partners
no_data: No data available. Please import a GEDCOM file.
select_prompt: Select an entry to view all details.
delete_tree_step1: Do you want to remove the selected tree "{tree}"?
delete_tree_step2: The selected tree "{tree}" will be permanently removed.
free_view_option: All Views / Free View (no Root Ancestor)
free_query_title: Free Family Tree View – Select Person
free_query_subtitle: Search for a specific person to explore the family tree freely (without reference to a defined root ancestor).
collapse_ancestors_tooltip: Collapse all ancestor generations for this entry
collapse_children_tooltip: Collapse all descendant generations for this entry
switch_leading_parent_tooltip: Switch as leading parent entry (closes expanded nodes of the other parent)
jump_to_spouse_tooltip: Open entry and corresponding generations in the family tree
shortest_path_spouse_slider_tooltip: Include connections via spouses when calculating and displaying the shortest path
design_select_proband_title: Tree Design Mode – Select Root Ancestor
design_select_proband_subtitle: A defined root ancestor must be selected for Design Mode. Once selected, the family tree is displayed bottom-to-top with the root ancestor as the origin.
design_move_group_up: Move sibling group one level up
design_move_group_down: Move sibling group one level down
design_split_group_level: Insert a new level above and move group there
design_hint: Mouse wheel controls smooth zoom (cursor-centered). Docked entries move together as a cluster. Crossing edges receive line bridges.
design_ungroup_tooltip: Dissolve sibling group and display siblings as individual entries
design_regroup_tooltip: Merge ungrouped siblings back into a sibling group
design_dock_left: Dock flush to left neighbor entry
design_dock_right: Dock flush to right neighbor entry
design_draw_width_active: 🖱️ Drag horizontally on the level of {name} to draw width (or drag handles ◀ ▶)...
design_card_width_tooltip: Set / draw width on the current level for this entry (places all descendant entries inside and excludes other branches above)
design_detach_person_tooltip: Detach this entry and any descendants from group (descendants form new groups per level)
design_group_row_tooltip: Group all entries of this row/level into a single group
design_ungroup_left_tooltip: Dissolve grouping to the left (separates chosen entry or sibling group to the left)
design_ungroup_right_tooltip: Dissolve grouping to the right (separates chosen entry or sibling group to the right)
design_save_tooltip: Save current state of tree design (multiple versions supported)
design_load_tooltip: Load previously saved design state or open from file
design_no_presets: No saved states available for this root ancestor yet.
design_delete_preset_confirm: Do you really want to delete this saved state?
design_open_file_hint: Choose a design file (.json) that was shared with you:
design_load_file_success: Design state loaded successfully from file.
design_auto_sublanes_label: Automatically add new lanes for horizontal segments when space permits
design_undo_tooltip: Undo last action in Design Mode (Ctrl+Z)
design_overwrite_warn: A state with this name already exists and will be overwritten.
design_enable_bridges_label: Show line bridges at line crossings
design_minimize_bridges_label: Optimize crossbar lane arrangement (minimize line bridges)
design_minimize_bridges_hint: Arranges outer connections on lower levels and inner connections on higher levels to systematically minimize line bridges and intersections with vertical lines.
